conclusion: The v6 campaign remains the canonical append-only continuation record. It verifies the Type1E wall opening, the far-rope sword transfer, and the complete bounded probe set around the behavior-0x24 endpoint and x≈4688 marker. Those local branches are now classified as exhausted negative evidence; the level remains in SCENE_STATE=0x01 and the natural exit is unresolved. The next productive work is static/decompiler tracing of the remaining upper-route actor or launch condition, not another identical Up/rope sweep.
